title: A real torch at night and in the Mawdeep
changes: Your hero now carries a lit torch: a flame in the hand and a wide, flickering pool of warm light that cuts through the dark
Works at night and down in the Mawdeep; the torch is lit by default, L puts it out or lights it again
Bottom bar: on screens where it leaves too little room, the statues step aside and chat moves up above the bar
